LESSON: THE INTERDEPENDENCE OF LIFE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
Strand: Living things and their Environment
Topic 2.4: The Interdependence of Life

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: The Interdependence of Life
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What is the role of living and non-living factors in environments?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the biotic and abiotic factors of the environment
2. construct food chains and food webs in the environment
3. describe the effect of human activities on the environment
4. appreciate the interdependence between living and non-living factors of the environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ The Interdependence of Life

Teach
• Observe The Interdependence of Life in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about The Interdependence of Life (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to The Interdependence of Life.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for The Interdependence of Life.
• Write 5 bullet facts about The Interdependence of Life.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain the biotic and abiotic factors of the environment
• construct food chains and food webs in the environment
• describe the effect of human activities on the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on The Interdependence of Life.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for The Interdependence of Life: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of living and non-living factors in environments?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the biotic and abiotic factors of the environment
• construct food chains and food webs in the environment
• describe the effect of human activities on the environment
• appreciate the interdependence between living and non-living factors of the environment

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
